name: Archon
description: Runs coding agents through YAML-defined workflows (plan, implement, validate, review, open a PR), each in its own git worktree, driven from CLI, web UI, Slack, or GitHub.

skills.name: YAML Workflow Execution
skills.description: Executes DAG workflows defined in .archon/workflows, mixing AI prompt nodes with deterministic bash, script, and git nodes.

skills.name: Worktree Run Isolation
skills.description: Gives every workflow run its own git worktree and branch so several runs proceed in parallel without conflicts.

skills.name: Issue To PR Pipeline
skills.description: Ships workflows that classify a GitHub issue, plan, implement, validate, open a pull request, and self-fix review findings.

skills.name: Visual Workflow Builder
skills.description: Creates and edits DAG workflows with loop and human-approval nodes in a drag-and-drop web editor backed by YAML.

skills.name: Multi Platform Adapters
skills.description: Starts and monitors runs from CLI, web UI, Slack, Telegram, Discord, or GitHub webhooks in one shared activity view.
